sloka: मम सत्या प्रतिज्ञा सा वीर्य शुल्का इति कौशिक ।सीता प्राणैः बहुमता देया रामाय मे सुता ॥१-६७-२३॥
transliteration: mama satyā pratijñā sā vīrya śulkā iti kauśika ।sītā prāṇaiḥ bahumatā deyā rāmāya me sutā ॥1-67-23॥

translations.english: O Son of Kausika I announce Sita to be the 'Reward of prowess'. My vow has come true. She is more valuable than my life and fit to be given to Rama.
